item.title: Delphium cover on RX5 and TX802
item.description: video upload by Collector Current "In this video I show you how I made a cover of the Aphex Twin song 'Delphium' from the album Selected Ambient Works 85-92. Just like with my cover of 'Aegispolis', I used the Yamaha RX5 with custom samples loaded on an RX5USB board, and a Yamaha TX802 sequenced by the Roland MSQ-700. Blog: https://blog.jacobvosmaer.nl/ Music: https://music.jacobvosmaer.nl/"
